vehicle.description:
The Ariel Nomad is an off-road buggy produced from 2016 until 2022 by Ariel Motor Company, a low-volume manufacturer based in Crewkerne, in Somerset, England.

Built on an Ariel Atom steel-tube chassis, the Nomad is powered by a Honda-sourced 2.4L (2,354 cc) K24Z7 iVTEC four-cylinder engine with power and torque rated at and ( and in Forza) respectively. Coupled to a 6-speed manual gearbox with a limited-slip differential, the Nomad weighs only ( in Forza) and features a double unequal length fabricated wishbone suspension setup.

It was succeeded by the Ariel Nomad 2 in 2024.
